hints.env: Leave empty to watch every environment of the application.
hints.ids: Comma separated ids; empty watches all.
hints.idsOtherType: Used when the target type is {{type}}.
hints.window: Data the rule evaluates, e.g. 30s, 5m, 1h (5 s to 24 h).
hints.for: How long the condition must hold before the alert fires, e.g. 0s, 5m.
hints.minSamples: Requests needed in the window before the rule evaluates (low traffic does not fire).
hints.minSamplesNotRequest: Only request metrics use a minimum number of samples.
hints.recoverThreshold: Empty: the alert resolves when the condition is no longer met.
hints.warmupGrace: No alerts this long after an instance starts, e.g. 3m.
hints.activeTime: Empty: the rule is active all the time (server time zone).
hints.muteSchedules: Planned quiet periods such as nightly batch windows (at most 7 days each).
hints.renotify: 0 sends no reminders; otherwise at least 5m.
hints.runbook: An http or https link sent with the notification.
hints.metricUnavailable: This version does not compute this metric: the rule never fires.
